messages.subject: request: general purpose adaptive throttling
parts:
Wherein I drag across an input to request a series of outputs, either a slider or a dropdown or a JS client.

shiny to provide a tagged response time.

use case:

I send requests at a default throttle of .5ms.  server either takes:

1s to complete each - wasting 50% of requests

.1s to complete each, meaning responsiveness is slow for no good reason

suggestion: for a given key, record recent response times.

key might be... input which triggered update, or output identity.

uses:

* optimise response time.
* provide mechanism to allow minimal primary response, followed by detail view if input stopped or available time
* provide selection mechanism between minimal + maximal or maximal only, based upon analysis of min/max response times and optimal latency

suggestion: reactive mechanism to partially satisfy response - minial or partial or summarised response to be automatically followed by maximal response unless new request received, in which case new minimal will be transmitted.

compare: browse through images and get low dip image each time unless user browse stops, when full res is displayed (google images, apple aperture).

-Alex
